style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: Krishna says he acts without negligence so people do not copy him
candidates.evidence: यदि ह्यहं न वर्तेयं जातु कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः । मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥

candidates.angle: He warns that if he stopped acting, people would follow his inaction
candidates.evidence: यदि मैं कर्म न करूँ, तो ये सब मनुष्य नष्टभ्रष्ट हो जायँ

candidates.angle: He says he would be the cause of social disorder if he stopped working
candidates.evidence: मैं वर्णसंकरताको करनेवाला होऊँ तथा इस समस्त प्रजाको नष्ट करनेवाला बनूँ

angle_hi: कृष्ण का उदाहरण दुनिया चलाता है

en.intro: Krishna tells Arjuna that he works with care because everyone watches him. Listen for the warning hidden inside that reason.
en.notice: Here he says that if he ever stopped working, people would copy that inaction, and he would be the cause of disorder.
en.next: He then explains that if he stopped, the whole world would fall into ruin.
en.meaning: For if I ever stopped acting with care, people would follow my path in every way, Arjuna.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि वे सावधानी से काम करते हैं क्योंकि सब उन्हें देखते हैं। इस बात में छिपी चेतावनी को सुनिए।
hi.meaning: हे पार्थ, यदि मैं कभी आलस्य छोड़कर सावधानी से कर्म में न लगूँ, तो बड़ी हानि हो। क्योंकि मनुष्य हर तरह से मेरे ही मार्ग का अनुसरण करते हैं।
hi.notice: यहाँ वे कहते हैं कि यदि वे कभी काम करना छोड़ दें, तो लोग उस निष्क्रियता की नकल करेंगे, और वे ही अव्यवस्था का कारण बनेंगे।
hi.next: वे आगे बताते हैं कि यदि वे काम करना छोड़ दें, तो सारी सृष्टि नष्ट हो जाएगी।

en.intro: Krishna tells Arjuna that he works with care because everyone watches him. Listen for the warning hidden inside that reason.
en.body: For if I ever stopped acting with care, people would follow my path in every way, Arjuna. Here he says that if he ever stopped working, people would copy that inaction, and he would be the cause of disorder. He then explains that if he stopped, the whole world would fall into ruin.
